title: Motie van het lid Beckerman over een bevoegde instantie aanwijzen om ook deepfakeporno en andere onrechtmatige seksuele beelden offline te halen

reading.body:
Deepfake pornographic videos featuring the faces of Dutch public figures were distributed on an online platform. The videos were created by digitally placing victims' faces onto adult content without consent. This is a failure of platform moderation to prevent the creation or spread of illegal sexual abuse material.

The deployment failure was in the platform's systems for detecting and removing such content before it reached viewers. The victims discovered the videos themselves rather than being notified by the platform. Catching this would have required automated detection of deepfake sexual imagery, human review of flagged content, or mechanisms for rapid takedown when reported.

Whether the platform knew about the content before victims reported it, or what measures it had in place to prevent such uploads, is not established from the reporting. The incident prompted calls for authorities to designate a body responsible for removing illegal sexual imagery from online platforms.

summary:
Several well-known Dutch women are considering legal action after discovering themselves in fake pornographic videos. These manipulated videos appear on an online platform with 13 million monthly visitors and feature Dutch entertainers, television hosts, Olympic athletes, former government officials, mayors, and members of the royal family. Justice minister Yesilgöz called the videos disgusting and urged victims to file complaints. Managers and representatives of various victims confirmed to news outlets that they have filed reports or are considering legal action to address this violation.

Deepfake pornography, where someone's face is digitally placed onto adult content, is considered revenge porn and therefore illegal in the Netherlands. Attorneys recommend victims file reports with authorities, who may then attempt to shut down the websites hosting the material. Victims also have options including starting group lawsuits, filing complaints with data protection authorities, or contacting hosting companies. A previous case involved television presenter Welmoed Sijtsma, whose attacker received a conditional sentence of 180 hours in November.
title_en: Motion by member Beckerman on designating a competent authority to also remove deepfake pornography and other unlawful sexual images offline
